eligibility_note: Exclusion E4 is right. The paper is a differential-equation model of labour productivity (Eqs. 10-27) with simulated projections to 2042. The only data use is a US-based technological-progress curve built from BLS and Groningen series, checked against the model with a 1.95% mean squared approximation error. There are no regressions and no multi-country estimation, and no income-group comparison.

risk_of_bias.why: Not applicable, because the paper is excluded as a mathematical model with no own estimation.

problems: none. Record is consistent with the text (abstract; US-based calibration, p. 33: 'the mean squared error of approximation is 1.95%').
